mainEntity.name: Are there specific maintenance requirements after surface restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, proper maintenance is crucial to maximize the lifespan of your restored surface. Maintenance requirements vary by material and the type of protective coatings applied. Generally, regular cleaning to remove dirt and debris, avoiding harsh chemicals, and prompt attention to minor damages can help preserve the integrity and appearance. We provide specific recommendations based on the materials used in your project, ensuring you understand what steps to take to care for your newly restored surface effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance varies by material and coating, but generally involves regular cleaning and avoiding harsh chemicals to prolong the surface's lifespan. We provide specific care guidelines.
